meta.description: A 2D virtual office: proximity voice, screen sharing and shared notes.
landing.title: A 2D office where your team works and talks together.
landing.lead: Every group gets its own room. Walk up to a teammate to talk, share your screen with whoever is nearby, and keep notes on the room whiteboard.
landing.previewAlt: Preview of the 2D office with characters walking around
landing.f1.title: Proximity voice
landing.f1.body: The closer you are, the clearer you hear. Walk away and voices fade, just like a real office.
landing.f2.title: Screen sharing
landing.f2.body: Show your screen to the people around you and stop with one click.
landing.f3.title: Private & shared notes
landing.f3.body: Private notes save automatically; the room whiteboard is readable by every member.
landing.footer: Work • Talk • Together. A personal project; coins are virtual only.

tips.title: Quick tips
tips.sub: Three things to get you started.
tips.1.title: Tap to walk
tips.1.body: Tap or click anywhere on the map and your avatar finds its way. Use the "Go to…" menu to navigate with the keyboard.
tips.2.title: Walk up to talk
tips.2.body: Voices get louder as you get closer. The meeting room is private: knock first if it's in use.
tips.3.title: Objects do things
tips.3.body: Walk up to chairs, whiteboards or desks to see what they do: sit, open shared notes or your private notes.
